title: Compliment Relay
prompt: Take turns sharing three specific things you appreciate about each other.
reward_text: A shared smile and a high five.

title: The Five-Minute Sketch
prompt: Draw each other's favorite place without looking at a reference.
reward_text: Put both drawings on the fridge.

title: Mini Food Lab
prompt: Create a new snack using only ingredients you already have.
reward_text: Invent a name for your recipe.

title: Memory Postcard
prompt: Write a short postcard about a favorite fictional adventure.

title: Playlist Swap
prompt: Pick one song each that captures this week. Explain why.

title: The Curiosity Game
prompt: Each ask one question you've never asked before. Listen fully.

title: Neighborhood Explorer
prompt: Choose a nearby spot for a short walk and take three interesting photos.
